title: Tensor comparison uniqueness on flat representatives
statement: Let (C,J,R) and (C′,J′,S) be essentially small ringed sites in the coefficient universe. Let F : Mod(J,R) → Mod(J′,S) be additive and exact, and A,B their recorded closed derived tensor structures with tensor models TA,TB. Let m,n : tensor_A ⋙ D(F) ≅ (D(F)×D(F)) ⋙ tensor_B. Suppose K is a TensorComparisonModel for m and the inverse representative rectangle of n is Q(K.chain(P,Q)) for every pair of K-flat complexes P,Q with flat terms, using K.kflat and the same TA,TB model isomorphisms. Then m=n. No condition is imposed on arbitrary derived objects: equality is detected by faithful restriction to the stated representative class. proof.text: Restriction along the localization of pairs of K-flat flat-term representatives is faithful. At each representative pair cancel the invertible tensor model and exact factorization maps, then compare the given inverse rectangles.
